services.value: Provides regulatory compliance laboratory services for the City’s wastewater treatment plants, including sample collection and daily analysis. Testing services include metals (e.g., ICP/ICP-MS and Mercury Cold Vapor), microbiological indicators (fecal coliform/E. coli/Enterococcus), industrial waste and sludge testing (e.g., cyanide/sulfide; Class A/B sludge), routine chemistry (e.g., BOD/CBOD, TSS, ammonia), and organics (BNAs, herbicides, pesticides, volatiles).
